profile.headline: Software Engineer at GeodesicGames
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with experience in .NET, web, and mobile development. My hobbies include developing video games, playing the piano, and doing mathematics and physics puzzles.

See my personal website (link in the sidebar) to see a list of current and past projects, read some of my blog posts, and link to my GitHub.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on ITSM desktop and web applications using C#/.NET, WinForms, WPF, ASP.NET, HTML/CSS, and Javascript.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on ITSM desktop and web applications using C#/.NET, WinForms, WPF, ASP.NET, HTML/CSS, and Javascript.

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description: Worked in Xamarin to develop Android and iOS mobile applications.

positions.title: Experimental Optics Researcher
positions.description: Worked in on-campus optics laboratory researching laser phenomena.  Developed mathematical models, created LabVIEW scripts to automate experiments, wrote lab reports, and presented findings to University students and faculty.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Participated in Cherwell's summer internship program as a software development intern.  Worked in C# and WPF to develop widget prototypes using third-party libraries.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Worked as an intern at Missing Link Tools, LLC (which was acquired by Methodics, Inc while there) using Perl, Python, and C++.
